messages:
Arielle Park: Quick kickoff  Hybrid Roadshow w/CloudNexus confirmed for Sept 8. We'll run a 40min talk + 30min interactive demo. Need: speaker rotation, demo handoff plan, local kit contents, and swag pickup windows.

Noah Grant: On it. Who's doing the speaker rotation table? I can draft a short handoff checklist per presenter.

Arielle Park: @Noah please draft. We want a live demo in-person with remote partner co-hosting. Also need prerecorded fallback for remote-only failures.

Ivy Chen: I'll produce a 5min fallback clip (MP4, 720p). Will include short subtitles and a transcript file. Drop link here when done.

Mateo Ruiz: For local kits: propose USB with runbook, sticker, and an ethernet cable for demo network fallback. Value low to avoid customs issues. Agree?

Sophie (events): Agree. SKU list needed for customs: RDW-SK-021 (stickers), RDW-KIT-021 (USB+card). Declared value per kit $8.00. Shipping windows: SF warehouse arrival 9/3, EU hub 9/4.

LogisticsBot: Reminder: include HS codes and commercial invoice. Undelivered returns held 30 days then donated.

Noah Grant: Handoff checklist (draft):
- T-5min: confirm AV + network
- T-2min: switch slide to "Live Demo"
- At handoff: run health-check script, announce switch in chat
- If remote lags >30s: trigger prerecorded clip

Ivy Chen: For the prerecord, will include a short CLI snippet in the description:
```
# live fallback
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDACTORY
python demo_run.py --model redwood-lite --host https://api.redwood.com
```

Sophie (events): Registration form: add "ship swag?" opt-in + shipping address for winners only. Legal says we can't store addresses longer than 90 days. Also add phone optional for courier.

Mateo Ruiz: For demo content on USB: include README + small sample inputs and a script to fetch a small test artifact from our secure bucket. Avoid shipping any checkpoints.

Arielle Park: Good call. Also, partner wants to share recording externally. Approve with attribution and linkback to Redwood docs, per policy.

Noah Grant: Rehearsal windows: full run-through 9/5 11:00 PT, quick dress 9/7 09:00 PT. Who volunteers infra on-call?

Mateo Ruiz: I'll be on-call for NA window. @Ivy can you cover fallback trigger and playback?

Ivy Chen: Yep. I'll make a playback checklist and provide the file.

Sophie (events): Courier contact: BlueParcel ref #BP-7781. I'll finalize receivers: SF -> "Redwood Events (attn: Warehouse)"; EU -> "CloudNexus Events (attn: Ops)".

LogisticsBot: Scheduled pickups set for 9/1-9/2. Tracking will be posted once labels created.

Arielle Park: Final owners: Noah (speaker grid & runbook), Ivy (fallback + media), Mateo (infra + on-call), Sophie (swag & courier). Let's reconvene 9/3 for a final slot check. :white_check_mark:
